headline: MTN Nigeria 9M Pre-Tax Profit Rises to N1.80 Trillion on Higher Revenue
summary: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc reported a 59.4% increase in pre-tax profit to N1.80 trillion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, as revenue reached N4.61 trillion.
why: MTN Nigeria is one of the largest telecommunications providers in Africa's most populous nation, serving as a key bellwether for corporate earnings and consumer demand in the region.

impacts.name: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc
impacts.why: Significant profit and revenue growth positively reflect on the company's financial performance.
